1→# DuckDB Data Agent
     2→
     3→> **Note:** This project is built with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/product/claude-code)(using Opus 4.6 and [superpowers](https://github.com/obra/superpowers)) by more than 95% and human-reviewed by author.
     4→
     5→[![Deploy to Render](https://render.com/images/deploy-to-render-button.svg)](https://render.com/deploy)
     6→
     7→An AI-powered data analysis agent with a built-in SQL playground. Upload data files (CSV, JSON, Parquet, Excel) and ask questions in plain English, or switch to the SQL editor for direct queries — powered by [DuckDB](https://duckdb.org/) on a lightweight [FastAPI](https://fastapi.tiangolo.com/) backend with a React frontend. The app opens in Agent Mode by default so you can start analyzing data immediately.
     8→
     9→Each browser tab gets its own isolated, in-memory DuckDB session — uploaded data and query state are fully isolated between users and tabs, with idle sessions automatically cleaned up after 5 minutes of inactivity.
    10→
    11→## Features
    12→
    13→### General
    14→
    15→- **Per-user DuckDB sessions** — Each browser tab gets its own isolated in-memory DuckDB instance, identified by a `X-Session-ID` header generated client-side; data and state are never shared between users or tabs; idle sessions are automatically cleaned up after 5 minutes
    16→- **DuckDB SQL engine** — Fast, in-process analytical database on the backend
    17→- **Multi-format file upload** — Drag-and-drop or click to import CSV, JSON, Parquet, and Excel (.xlsx) files (default limit: 500 MB, configurable via `MAX_TOTAL_SIZE_BYTES` env var) with automatic schema detection; Excel workbooks with multiple sheets create one table per sheet; duplicate filename detection prevents accidental overwrites; the upload UI appears when no tables are loaded, and files can also be added via the sidebar upload button
    18→- **Sample dataset** — One-click load of the Titanic dataset to get started quickly
    19→- **Table sidebar** — Collapsible panel to browse tables, inspect columns, and view types
    20→- **Dark / light mode** — Toggle between dark and light themes with the sun/moon button in the header; respects your OS preference on first visit and remembers your choice across sessions
    21→- **Internationalization (i18n)** — Switch between English and Traditional Chinese with the EN/中 toggle in the header; auto-detects your OS language on first visit and remembers your choice across sessions
    22→
    23→### Agent Mode (default mode)
    24→
    25→- **Natural language queries** — Ask questions about your data in plain English; the agent writes and executes SQL for you
    26→- **Streaming responses** — Real-time token streaming powered by Claude via the [Anthropic Agent SDK](https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python)
    27→- **Visible reasoning** — Collapsible thinking block shows the agent's intermediate steps and SQL queries
    28→- **Inline results** — Query results rendered inline within the conversation
    29→- **Edit & delete messages** — Hover over any user message to edit or delete it; editing re-sends the modified query with prior conversation as context, deleting rewinds the conversation to that point
    30→- **Credential proxy** — The backend runs a built-in Anthropic API reverse proxy; each agent session receives a short-lived UUID token instead of the real API key, so the Claude Code subprocess never has access to `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`; tokens are revoked immediately when the session ends (see [Security](#security))
    31→- **Privacy-conscious** — Requires an Anthropic API key stored in a server-side `.env` file; your data and credentials are never sent anywhere besides the Anthropic API
    32→- **Langfuse observability** (optional) — Built-in [Langfuse](https://langfuse.com/) tracing for monitoring agent interactions, with a one-click dashboard link in the UI
    33→
    34→### Editor Mode
    35→
    36→- **SQL query editor** — Write and execute queries with Ctrl/Cmd+Enter
    37→- **Interactive results** — Sortable columns, per-column filters, and global search across results
    38→- **EXPLAIN support** — Markdown-rendered output for `EXPLAIN` and `EXPLAIN ANALYZE` queries
    39→
    40→## Getting Started
    41→
    42→### Prerequisites
    43→
    44→- [Node.js](https://nodejs.org/) 20+
    45→- [Python](https://www.python.org/) 3.12+
    46→- [Poetry](https://python-poetry.org/)
    47→
    48→### Installation
    49→
    50→```bash
    51→make install
    52→```
    53→
    54→Or install frontend and backend separately:
    55→
    56→```bash
    57→cd frontend && npm install
    58→cd backend && poetry install
    59→```
    60→
    61→### Configuration
    62→
    63→Copy the example environment file and add your credentials:
    64→
    65→```bash
    66→cp backend/.env.example backend/.env
    67→```
    68→
    69→Edit `backend/.env` and set your Anthropic API key:
    70→
    71→```
    72→ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=sk-ant-...
    73→ANTHROPIC_MODEL=sonnet              # optional, defaults to sonnet
    74→MAX_TOTAL_SIZE_BYTES=524288000      # optional, max upload size in bytes (default: 500 MB)
    75→```
    76→
    77→> `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` and `ANTHROPIC_MODEL` are only needed for the AI agent. The SQL playground works without them, but both require the backend running.
    78→
    79→#### Langfuse (optional)
    80→
    81→To enable agent tracing with [Langfuse](https://langfuse.com/), add these to `backend/.env`:
    82→
    83→```
    84→LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY=pk-lf-...
    85→LANGFUSE_SECRET_KEY=sk-lf-...
    86→LANGFUSE_BASE_URL=https://cloud.langfuse.com   # optional, defaults to cloud
    87→```
    88→
    89→When configured, every agent conversation is traced (LLM turns, tool calls, SQL execution) and a **Langfuse Traces** button appears in the agent panel header linking to your dashboard. When not configured, tracing is disabled with zero overhead.
    90→
    91→### Development
    92→
    93→Start both the frontend and backend:
    94→
    95→```bash
    96→make dev
    97→```
    98→
    99→Or run them separately:
   100→
   101→```bash
   102→make frontend   # http://localhost:5173
   103→make backend    # http://localhost:8000
   104→```
   105→
   106→Open http://localhost:5173 to use the app. The Vite dev server proxies `/api` requests to the backend automatically.
   107→
   108→## Production Build and Deployment
   109→
   110→The project ships as a single Docker image that bundles the React frontend and FastAPI backend. A multi-stage `Dockerfile` builds the frontend, then copies the output into the backend's static directory.
   111→
   112→### Build and run locally
   113→
   114→```bash
   115→docker build -t duckdb-data-agent .
   116→
   117→docker run -p 10000:10000 \
   118→  -e ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=sk-ant-... \
   119→  duckdb-data-agent
   120→```
   121→
   122→Add `-e LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY=pk-lf-... -e LANGFUSE_SECRET_KEY=sk-lf-...` to either command to enable Langfuse tracing.
   123→
   124→Open http://localhost:10000 to use the app.
   125→
   126→### Deploy to Render
   127→
   128→A `render.yaml` is included for one-click deployment on [Render](https://render.com/):
   129→
   130→1. Push this repo to GitHub.
   131→2. In Render, create a new **Blueprint** and connect the repo.
   132→3. Set `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` in the Render dashboard. Optionally set `ANTHROPIC_MODEL` to override the default model (`sonnet`). To enable Langfuse tracing, also set `LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY` and `LANGFUSE_SECRET_KEY`.
   133→
   134→Render will build the Docker image and deploy it automatically on every push to `main`.
   135→
   136→## Security
   137→
   138→### Credential Proxy
   139→
   140→When the agent runs, the backend spawns a Claude Code subprocess via the Anthropic Agent SDK. A naive approach would pass `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` directly into that subprocess's environment — but any tool or shell command the agent executes could then read and exfiltrate the key.
   141→
   142→Instead, the backend runs a built-in reverse proxy at `/anthropic` that sits between Claude Code and `api.anthropic.com`:
   143→
   144→```
   145→Claude Code subprocess
   146→  → ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:{PORT}/anthropic
   147→  → ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=<short-lived UUID token>
   148→        ↓
   149→FastAPI proxy (/anthropic/{path})
   150→  → validates UUID token
   151→  → swaps it for the real ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
   152→  → forwards request to api.anthropic.com
   153→```
   154→
   155→**How it works:**
   156→
   157→1. Before each agent session, the backend mints a random UUID token with a 10-minute TTL.
   158→2. The token is injected into the subprocess environment as `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`; the real key is never exposed.
   159→3. The proxy validates every inbound request against the token store and substitutes the real key before forwarding upstream.
   160→4. When the session ends, the token is explicitly revoked in a `finally` block, regardless of success or error.
   161→5. A background task runs every 60 seconds to sweep any tokens that outlived their TTL.
   162→
   163→The subprocess only ever holds a single-session UUID. Even if a tool call reads the environment, all it gets is a temporary token scoped to that conversation.
   164→
   165→## Project Structure
   166→
   167→```
   168→├── frontend/               # React frontend
   169→│   ├── src/
   170→│   │   ├── components/     #   UI components (editor, results, sidebar, chat)
   171→│   │   ├── contexts/       #   React context providers (theme, language, agent, config, session)
   172→│   │   ├── hooks/          #   Custom hooks (useTheme, useTranslation, useAgent, useConfig)
   173→│   │   ├── agent/          #   Agent service (SSE event handling, session ID injection)
   174→│   │   ├── i18n/           #   Translation files (en.json, zh-TW.json)
   175→│   │   └── types.ts        #   Shared TypeScript interfaces
   176→│   ├── index.html          #   HTML entry point
   177→│   ├── package.json        #   npm config
   178→│   └── vite.config.ts      #   Vite bundler config
   179→├── backend/                # FastAPI backend
   180→│   └── app/
   181→│       ├── main.py         #   App setup, CORS, and background session cleanup loop
   182→│       ├── config.py       #   Environment variables (API key, model, upload limits)
   183→│       ├── database.py     #   DuckDB connection, query execution, and per-user SessionManager
   184→│       ├── agent.py        #   Agent loop & SSE streaming
   185→│       ├── proxy.py        #   Credential proxy: token store + /anthropic reverse proxy
   186→│       ├── tracing.py      #   Langfuse client wrapper & initialization
   187→│       ├── tools.py        #   Agent SDK tool definitions (execute_sql)
   188→│       ├── data/           #   Sample datasets (titanic.csv)
   189→│       └── routes/         #   API endpoints (tables, query, chat, config, langfuse status, heartbeat)
   190→├── Dockerfile              # Multi-stage production build
   191→├── render.yaml             # Render deployment config
   192→└── Makefile                # Dev commands (install, dev, clean)
   193→```
   194→
   195→## Tech Stack
   196→
   197→**Frontend**
   198→- [React](https://react.dev/) 18 + [TypeScript](https://www.typescriptlang.org/)
   199→- [Vite](https://vite.dev/)
   200→
   201→**Backend**
   202→- [FastAPI](https://fastapi.tiangolo.com/) + [Uvicorn](https://www.uvicorn.org/)
   203→- [DuckDB](https://duckdb.org/) (Python)
   204→- [Anthropic Agent SDK](https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python)
   205→- [Langfuse](https://langfuse.com/) (optional, for observability)
   206→
   207→## License
   208→
   209→[MIT](LICENSE.txt)
   210→

1→# Containerized Claude Code Runtime Implementation Plan
     2→
     3→> **For Claude:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task.
     4→
     5→**Goal:** Run each Claude Code session inside a gVisor-sandboxed Docker container ("sidecar") for code execution sandboxing, multi-tenant isolation, and defense in depth.
     6→
     7→**Architecture:** A lightweight TypeScript HTTP server inside a Docker container wraps the Claude Agent SDK. The host FastAPI backend manages container lifecycle via Docker SDK for Python. DuckDB stays on the host; the sidecar reaches it via MCP over the host network. A feature flag (`CONTAINER_ENABLED`) allows fallback to the existing subprocess model.
     8→
     9→**Tech Stack:** TypeScript (sidecar server), Python (container manager), Docker SDK for Python (`docker` package), gVisor (`runsc` runtime), Express.js (sidecar HTTP framework)
    10→
    11→---
    12→
    13→### Task 1: Sidecar TypeScript project scaffolding
    14→
    15→**Files:**
    16→- Create: `sidecar/package.json`
    17→- Create: `sidecar/tsconfig.json`
    18→- Create: `sidecar/src/types.ts`
    19→
    20→**Step 1: Create `sidecar/package.json`**
    21→
    22→```json
    23→{
    24→  "name": "duckdb-agent-sidecar",
    25→  "version": "1.0.0",
    26→  "private": true,
    27→  "scripts": {
    28→    "build": "tsc",
    29→    "start": "node dist/server.js",
    30→    "dev": "tsx src/server.ts"
    31→  },
    32→  "dependencies": {
    33→    "express": "^4.21.0",
    34→    "claude-agent-sdk": "^0.1.38"
    35→  },
    36→  "devDependencies": {
    37→    "@types/express": "^5.0.0",
    38→    "@types/node": "^22.0.0",
    39→    "tsx": "^4.0.0",
    40→    "typescript": "^5.7.0"
    41→  }
    42→}
    43→```
    44→
    45→**Step 2: Create `sidecar/tsconfig.json`**
    46→
    47→```json
    48→{
    49→  "compilerOptions": {
    50→    "target": "ES2022",
    51→    "module": "NodeNext",
    52→    "moduleResolution": "NodeNext",
    53→    "outDir": "dist",
    54→    "rootDir": "src",
    55→    "strict": true,
    56→    "esModuleInterop": true,
    57→    "skipLibCheck": true,

    61→}
    62→```
    63→
    64→**Step 3: Create `sidecar/src/types.ts`**
    65→
    66→```typescript
    67→export interface QueryRequest {
    68→  message: string;
    69→  session_id?: string;
    70→  system_prompt: string;
    71→  model?: string;
    72→  mcp_server_url?: string;
    73→}

    78→}

    81→**Step 4: Install dependencies**

    91→**Step 6: Commit**

    96→```
    97→
    98→---
    99→
   100→### Task 2: Sidecar HTTP server implementation
   101→
   102→**Files:**
   103→- Create: `sidecar/src/server.ts`
   104→
   105→**Step 1: Write `sidecar/src/server.ts`**
   106→
   107→This is the thin HTTP wrapper around the Claude Agent SDK. It exposes three endpoints:
   108→
   109→- `GET /health` — readiness probe
   110→- `POST /query` — accept a query, stream SSE response
   111→- `POST /stop` — gracefully stop current session
   112→
   113→```typescript
   114→import express, { Request, Response } from "express";
   115→import { ClaudeSDKClient, ClaudeAgentOptions } from "claude-agent-sdk";
   116→import type { QueryRequest, HealthResponse } from "./types.js";
   117→
   118→const app = express();
   119→app.use(express.json());
   120→
   121→const PORT = parseInt(process.env.PORT || "3000", 10);
   122→
   123→// Track active client for /stop endpoint
   124→let activeClient: ClaudeSDKClient | null = null;
   125→
   126→app.get("/health", (_req: Request, res: Response) => {
   127→  const response: HealthResponse = { status: "ok" };
   128→  res.json(response);
   129→});
   130→
   131→app.post("/query", async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
   132→  const body = req.body as QueryRequest;
   133→
   134→  if (!body.message || !body.system_prompt) {
   135→    res.status(400).json({ error: "message and system_prompt are required" });
   136→    return;
   137→  }
   138→
   139→  // Set up SSE headers
   140→  res.setHeader("Content-Type", "text/event-stream");
   141→  res.setHeader("Cache-Control", "no-cache");
   142→  res.setHeader("Connection", "keep-alive");
   143→  res.setHeader("X-Accel-Buffering", "no");
   144→  res.flushHeaders();
   145→
   146→  const options: any = {
   147→    model: body.model || process.env.ANTHROPIC_MODEL || "claude-opus-4-6",
   148→    system_prompt: body.system_prompt,
   149→    allowed_tools: ["mcp__duckdb__execute_sql"],
   150→    permission_mode: "bypassPermissions",
   151→    max_turns: 20,
   152→    include_partial_messages: true,
   153→    ...(body.session_id ? { resume: body.session_id } : {}),
   154→  };
   155→
   156→  // Configure MCP server if URL is provided
   157→  if (body.mcp_server_url) {
   158→    options.mcp_servers = {
   159→      duckdb: {
   160→        type: "sse",
   161→        url: body.mcp_server_url,
   162→      },
   163→    };
   164→  }
   165→
   166→  const client = new ClaudeSDKClient(options);
   167→  activeClient = client;
   168→
   169→  try {
   170→    await client.connect();
   171→    await client.query(body.message, { session_id: body.session_id || "default" });
   172→
   173→    for await (const msg of client.receiveResponse()) {
   174→      // Forward all messages as JSON SSE events
   175→      // The host backend will parse and re-emit these
   176→      const data = JSON.stringify(msg);
   177→      res.write(`data: ${data}\n\n`);
   178→    }
   179→  } catch (err: any) {
   180→    const errorData = JSON.stringify({ type: "error", message: err.message || String(err) });
   181→    res.write(`event: error\ndata: ${errorData}\n\n`);
   182→  } finally {
   183→    activeClient = null;
   184→    try {
   185→      await client.disconnect();
   186→    } catch {
   187→      // ignore disconnect errors
   188→    }
   189→    res.end();
   190→  }
   191→});
   192→
   193→app.post("/stop", async (_req: Request, res: Response) => {
   194→  if (activeClient) {
   195→    try {
   196→      await activeClient.disconnect();
   197→    } catch {
   198→      // ignore
   199→    }
   200→    activeClient = null;
   201→    res.json({ status: "stopped" });
   202→  } else {
   203→    res.json({ status: "no_active_session" });
   204→  }
   205→});
   206→
   207→app.listen(PORT, "0.0.0.0", () => {
   208→  console.log(`Sidecar agent server listening on port ${PORT}`);
   209→});
   210→```
   211→
   212→> **Note:** The exact Claude Agent SDK TypeScript API may differ from the Python SDK. The implementer should check the `claude-agent-sdk` npm package documentation and adjust the import paths, class names, and method signatures accordingly. The core pattern (connect → query → receive stream → disconnect) should be the same. If the npm package doesn't exist or has a different API, use `@anthropic-ai/claude-code` CLI subprocess spawning with `--output-format stream-json` instead.
   213→
   214→**Step 2: Verify TypeScript compiles**
   215→
   216→Run: `cd sidecar && npx tsc --noEmit`
   217→Expected: No errors (or minimal fixable errors from SDK type mismatches).
   218→
   219→**Step 3: Commit**

   223→git commit -m "feat(sidecar): implement HTTP server wrapping Claude Agent SDK"
   224→```

   549→class ContainerConfig:
   550→    image: str = "duckdb-agent-sidecar:latest"
   551→    runtime: str = "runsc"
   552→    memory_limit: str = "256m"
   553→    cpu_limit: float = 0.5
   554→    max_lifetime_seconds: int = 600
   555→    network: str = "agent-sandbox"
   556→
   557→
   558→@dataclass
   559→class ContainerInfo:
   560→    container_id: str
   561→    session_id: str
   562→    ip_address: str
   563→    port: int = 3000
   564→    created_at: datetime = field(default_factory=lambda: datetime.now(timezone.utc))
   565→    _container: object = field(default=None, repr=False)
   566→
   567→    @property
   568→    def url(self) -> str:
   569→        return f"http://{self.ip_address}:{self.port}"
   570→
   571→
   572→class ContainerManager:
   573→    """Manages per-session gVisor-sandboxed sidecar containers."""
   574→
   575→    def __init__(self, config: ContainerConfig | None = None):
   576→        self._config = config or ContainerConfig()
   577→        self._client = docker.from_env()
   578→        self._containers: dict[str, ContainerInfo] = {}
   579→
   580→    def create(self, session_id: str, env: dict[str, str]) -> ContainerInfo:
   581→        """Spin up a new sidecar container for a session."""
   582→        if session_id in self._containers:
   583→            return self._containers[session_id]
   584→
   585→        container = self._client.containers.run(
   586→            image=self._config.image,
   587→            detach=True,
   588→            runtime=self._config.runtime,
   589→            mem_limit=self._config.memory_limit,
   590→            nano_cpus=int(self._config.cpu_limit * 1e9),
   591→            read_only=True,
   592→            cap_drop=["ALL"],
   593→            security_opt=["no-new-privileges"],
   594→            tmpfs={"/tmp": "size=50m"},
   595→            network=self._config.network,
   596→            environment=env,
   597→            labels={
   598→                "app": "duckdb-agent-sidecar",
   599→                "session_id": session_id,
   600→            },
   601→            auto_remove=False,  # We remove manually to handle errors
   602→        )
   603→
   604→        # Reload to get network info
   605→        container.reload()
   606→        networks = container.attrs.get("NetworkSettings", {}).get("Networks", {})
   607→        network_info = networks.get(self._config.network, {})
   608→        ip_address = network_info.get("IPAddress", "127.0.0.1")
   609→
   610→        info = ContainerInfo(
   611→            container_id=container.id,
   612→            session_id=session_id,
   613→            ip_address=ip_address,
   614→            _container=container,
   615→        )
   616→        self._containers[session_id] = info
   617→        logger.info(
   618→            "Created sidecar container %s for session %s at %s",
   619→            container.id[:12],
   620→            session_id,
   621→            info.url,
   622→        )
   623→        return info
   624→
   625→    def get(self, session_id: str) -> ContainerInfo | None:
   626→        """Get container info for a session."""
   627→        return self._containers.get(session_id)
   628→
   629→    def stop(self, session_id: str) -> None:
   630→        """Stop and remove the container for a session."""
   631→        info = self._containers.pop(session_id, None)
   632→        if info is None:
   633→            return
   634→
   635→        container = info._container
   636→        try:
   637→            container.stop(timeout=5)
   638→        except Exception as e:
   639→            logger.warning("Failed to stop container %s: %s", info.container_id[:12], e)
   640→        try:
   641→            container.remove(force=True)
   642→        except Exception as e:
   643→            logger.warning("Failed to remove container %s: %s", info.container_id[:12], e)
   644→
   645→        logger.info("Stopped sidecar container %s for session %s", info.container_id[:12], session_id)
   646→
   647→    def cleanup_expired(self) -> int:
   648→        """Remove containers that have exceeded max lifetime."""
   649→        cutoff = datetime.now(timezone.utc) - timedelta(seconds=self._config.max_lifetime_seconds)
   650→        expired = [
   651→            sid for sid, info in self._containers.items()
   652→            if info.created_at < cutoff
   653→        ]
   654→        for sid in expired:
   655→            logger.info("Container for session %s exceeded max lifetime, removing", sid)
   656→            self.stop(sid)
   657→        return len(expired)
   658→
   659→    def shutdown_all(self) -> None:
   660→        """Stop and remove all active containers. Called on backend shutdown."""
   661→        session_ids = list(self._containers.keys())
   662→        for sid in session_ids:
   663→            self.stop(sid)
   664→        logger.info("Shut down %d sidecar containers", len(session_ids))
   665→```

## Summary

I created the file `/Users/cyyeh/Desktop/duckdb-data-agent/.claude/worktrees/containerized-runtime/sidecar/src/server.ts` implementing the sidecar HTTP server. Here is what the server does:

### Endpoints

1. **`GET /health`** -- Returns `{"status":"ok"}` for readiness probes.

2. **`POST /query`** -- Accepts a `QueryRequest` JSON body with `message`, `system_prompt`, and optional `session_id`, `model`, and `mcp_server_url` fields. It:
   - Validates that `message` and `system_prompt` are present (returns 400 if not).
   - Sets up SSE response headers (`Content-Type: text/event-stream`, etc.).
   - If `mcp_server_url` is provided, writes a temporary MCP config JSON file for the `--mcp-config` flag.
   - Spawns the `claude` CLI binary as a child process with `--output-format stream-json`, `--permission-mode bypassPermissions`, `--max-turns 20`, and other relevant flags.
   - Streams stdout line-by-line as SSE `data:` events.
   - On process close, flushes any remaining buffered data, cleans up the temp MCP config file, and sends an error event if the exit code was non-zero.
   - Handles client disconnects by sending SIGTERM to the subprocess.

3. **`POST /stop`** -- Gracefully stops the active CLI subprocess by sending SIGTERM. Returns `{"status":"stopped"}` or `{"status":"no_active_session"}`.

### Key implementation details

- Uses `child_process.spawn` (not an npm SDK) to invoke the globally-installed `@anthropic-ai/claude-code` CLI binary.
- The CLI automatically reads `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` and `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` from the environment.
- TypeScript compiles cleanly with `npx tsc --noEmit` (zero errors).
- Committed as `14e697e feat(sidecar): implement HTTP server wrapping Claude CLI subprocess`.

## Task Description

**Files:**

node_modules
dist

```dockerfile
FROM python:3.12-slim AS base

# Install Node.js 20
RUN apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends curl ca-certificates && \
    curl -fsSL https://deb.nodesource.com/setup_20.x | bash - && \
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends nodejs && \
    apt-get clean && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Install Claude CLI globally
RUN npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code

# Build the sidecar server
WORKDIR /app
COPY package.json package-lock.json ./
RUN npm ci --omit=dev
COPY tsconfig.json ./
COPY src/ ./src/
RUN npx tsc

# Create non-root user
RUN useradd --create-home --shell /bin/bash appuser

USER appuser
EXPOSE 3000

CMD ["node", "dist/server.js"]
```

import logging
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone

import docker

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


@dataclass
class ContainerConfig:
    image: str = "duckdb-agent-sidecar:latest"
    runtime: str = "runsc"
    memory_limit: str = "256m"
    cpu_limit: float = 0.5
    max_lifetime_seconds: int = 600
    network: str = "agent-sandbox"


@dataclass
class ContainerInfo:
    container_id: str
    session_id: str
    ip_address: str
    port: int = 3000
    created_at: datetime = field(default_factory=lambda: datetime.now(timezone.utc))
    _container: object = field(default=None, repr=False)

    @property
    def url(self) -> str:
        return f"http://{self.ip_address}:{self.port}"


class ContainerManager:
    """Manages per-session gVisor-sandboxed sidecar containers."""

    def __init__(self, config: ContainerConfig | None = None):
        self._config = config or ContainerConfig()
        self._client = docker.from_env()
        self._containers: dict[str, ContainerInfo] = {}

    def create(self, session_id: str, env: dict[str, str]) -> ContainerInfo:
        """Spin up a new sidecar container for a session."""
        if session_id in self._containers:
            return self._containers[session_id]

        container = self._client.containers.run(
            image=self._config.image,
            detach=True,
            runtime=self._config.runtime,
            mem_limit=self._config.memory_limit,
            nano_cpus=int(self._config.cpu_limit * 1e9),
            read_only=True,
            cap_drop=["ALL"],
            security_opt=["no-new-privileges"],
            tmpfs={"/tmp": "size=50m"},
            network=self._config.network,
            environment=env,
            labels={
                "app": "duckdb-agent-sidecar",
                "session_id": session_id,
            },
            auto_remove=False,
        )

        container.reload()
        networks = container.attrs.get("NetworkSettings", {}).get("Networks", {})
        network_info = networks.get(self._config.network, {})
        ip_address = network_info.get("IPAddress", "127.0.0.1")

        info = ContainerInfo(
            container_id=container.id,
            session_id=session_id,
            ip_address=ip_address,
            _container=container,
        )
        self._containers[session_id] = info
        logger.info(
            "Created sidecar container %s for session %s at %s",
            container.id[:12],
            session_id,
            info.url,
        )
        return info

    def get(self, session_id: str) -> ContainerInfo | None:
        """Get container info for a session."""
        return self._containers.get(session_id)

    def stop(self, session_id: str) -> None:
        """Stop and remove the container for a session."""
        info = self._containers.pop(session_id, None)
        if info is None:
            return

        container = info._container
        try:
            container.stop(timeout=5)
        except Exception as e:
            logger.warning("Failed to stop container %s: %s", info.container_id[:12], e)
        try:
            container.remove(force=True)
        except Exception as e:
            logger.warning("Failed to remove container %s: %s", info.container_id[:12], e)

        logger.info("Stopped sidecar container %s for session %s", info.container_id[:12], session_id)

    def cleanup_expired(self) -> int:
        """Remove containers that have exceeded max lifetime."""
        cutoff = datetime.now(timezone.utc) - timedelta(seconds=self._config.max_lifetime_seconds)
        expired = [
            sid for sid, info in self._containers.items()
            if info.created_at < cutoff
        ]
        for sid in expired:
            logger.info("Container for session %s exceeded max lifetime, removing", sid)
            self.stop(sid)
        return len(expired)

    def shutdown_all(self) -> None:
        """Stop and remove all active containers. Called on backend shutdown."""
        session_ids = list(self._containers.keys())
        for sid in session_ids:
            self.stop(sid)
        logger.info("Shut down %d sidecar containers", len(session_ids))

import logging
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone

import docker

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


@dataclass
class ContainerConfig:
    image: str = "duckdb-agent-sidecar:latest"
    runtime: str = "runsc"
    memory_limit: str = "256m"
    cpu_limit: float = 0.5
    max_lifetime_seconds: int = 600
    network: str = "agent-sandbox"


@dataclass
class ContainerInfo:
    container_id: str
    session_id: str
    ip_address: str
    port: int = 3000
    created_at: datetime = field(default_factory=lambda: datetime.now(timezone.utc))
    _container: object = field(default=None, repr=False)

    @property
    def url(self) -> str:
        return f"http://{self.ip_address}:{self.port}"


class ContainerManager:
    """Manages per-session gVisor-sandboxed sidecar containers."""

    def __init__(self, config: ContainerConfig | None = None):
        self._config = config or ContainerConfig()
        self._client = docker.from_env()
        self._containers: dict[str, ContainerInfo] = {}

    def create(self, session_id: str, env: dict[str, str]) -> ContainerInfo:
        """Spin up a new sidecar container for a session."""
        if session_id in self._containers:
            return self._containers[session_id]

        container = self._client.containers.run(
            image=self._config.image,
            detach=True,
            runtime=self._config.runtime,
            mem_limit=self._config.memory_limit,
            nano_cpus=int(self._config.cpu_limit * 1e9),
            read_only=True,
            cap_drop=["ALL"],
            security_opt=["no-new-privileges"],
            tmpfs={"/tmp": "size=50m"},
            network=self._config.network,
            environment=env,
            labels={
                "app": "duckdb-agent-sidecar",
                "session_id": session_id,
            },
            auto_remove=False,
        )

        container.reload()
        networks = container.attrs.get("NetworkSettings", {}).get("Networks", {})
        network_info = networks.get(self._config.network, {})
        ip_address = network_info.get("IPAddress", "127.0.0.1")

        info = ContainerInfo(
            container_id=container.id,
            session_id=session_id,
            ip_address=ip_address,
            _container=container,
        )
        self._containers[session_id] = info
        logger.info(
            "Created sidecar container %s for session %s at %s",
            container.id[:12],
            session_id,
            info.url,
        )
        return info

    def get(self, session_id: str) -> ContainerInfo | None:
        """Get container info for a session."""
        return self._containers.get(session_id)

    def stop(self, session_id: str) -> None:
        """Stop and remove the container for a session."""
        info = self._containers.pop(session_id, None)
        if info is None:
            return

        container = info._container
        try:
            container.stop(timeout=5)
        except Exception as e:
            logger.warning("Failed to stop container %s: %s", info.container_id[:12], e)
        try:
            container.remove(force=True)
        except Exception as e:
            logger.warning("Failed to remove container %s: %s", info.container_id[:12], e)

        logger.info("Stopped sidecar container %s for session %s", info.container_id[:12], session_id)

    def cleanup_expired(self) -> int:
        """Remove containers that have exceeded max lifetime."""
        cutoff = datetime.now(timezone.utc) - timedelta(seconds=self._config.max_lifetime_seconds)
        expired = [
            sid for sid, info in self._containers.items()
            if info.created_at < cutoff
        ]
        for sid in expired:
            logger.info("Container for session %s exceeded max lifetime, removing", sid)
            self.stop(sid)
        return len(expired)

    def shutdown_all(self) -> None:
        """Stop and remove all active containers. Called on backend shutdown."""
        session_ids = list(self._containers.keys())
        for sid in session_ids:
            self.stop(sid)
        logger.info("Shut down %d sidecar containers", len(session_ids))

import logging
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone

import docker

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


@dataclass
class ContainerConfig:
    image: str = "duckdb-agent-sidecar:latest"
    runtime: str = "runsc"
    memory_limit: str = "256m"
    cpu_limit: float = 0.5
    max_lifetime_seconds: int = 600
    network: str = "agent-sandbox"


@dataclass
class ContainerInfo:
    container_id: str
    session_id: str
    ip_address: str
    port: int = 3000
    created_at: datetime = field(default_factory=lambda: datetime.now(timezone.utc))
    _container: object = field(default=None, repr=False)

    @property
    def url(self) -> str:
        return f"http://{self.ip_address}:{self.port}"


class ContainerManager:
    """Manages per-session gVisor-sandboxed sidecar containers."""

    def __init__(self, config: ContainerConfig | None = None):
        self._config = config or ContainerConfig()
        self._client = docker.from_env()
        self._containers: dict[str, ContainerInfo] = {}

    def create(self, session_id: str, env: dict[str, str]) -> ContainerInfo:
        """Spin up a new sidecar container for a session."""
        if session_id in self._containers:
            return self._containers[session_id]

        container = self._client.containers.run(
            image=self._config.image,
            detach=True,
            runtime=self._config.runtime,
            mem_limit=self._config.memory_limit,
            nano_cpus=int(self._config.cpu_limit * 1e9),
            read_only=True,
            cap_drop=["ALL"],
            security_opt=["no-new-privileges"],
            tmpfs={"/tmp": "size=50m"},
            network=self._config.network,
            environment=env,
            labels={
                "app": "duckdb-agent-sidecar",
                "session_id": session_id,
            },
            auto_remove=False,
        )

        container.reload()
        networks = container.attrs.get("NetworkSettings", {}).get("Networks", {})
        network_info = networks.get(self._config.network, {})
        ip_address = network_info.get("IPAddress", "127.0.0.1")

        info = ContainerInfo(
            container_id=container.id,
            session_id=session_id,
            ip_address=ip_address,
            _container=container,
        )
        self._containers[session_id] = info
        logger.info(
            "Created sidecar container %s for session %s at %s",
            container.id[:12],
            session_id,
            info.url,
        )
        return info

    def get(self, session_id: str) -> ContainerInfo | None:
        """Get container info for a session."""
        return self._containers.get(session_id)

    def stop(self, session_id: str) -> None:
        """Stop and remove the container for a session."""
        info = self._containers.pop(session_id, None)
        if info is None:
            return

        container = info._container
        try:
            container.stop(timeout=5)
        except Exception as e:
            logger.warning("Failed to stop container %s: %s", info.container_id[:12], e)
        try:
            container.remove(force=True)
        except Exception as e:
            logger.warning("Failed to remove container %s: %s", info.container_id[:12], e)

        logger.info("Stopped sidecar container %s for session %s", info.container_id[:12], session_id)

    def cleanup_expired(self) -> int:
        """Remove containers that have exceeded max lifetime."""
        cutoff = datetime.now(timezone.utc) - timedelta(seconds=self._config.max_lifetime_seconds)
        expired = [
            sid for sid, info in self._containers.items()
            if info.created_at < cutoff
        ]
        for sid in expired:
            logger.info("Container for session %s exceeded max lifetime, removing", sid)
            self.stop(sid)
        return len(expired)

    def shutdown_all(self) -> None:
        """Stop and remove all active containers. Called on backend shutdown."""
        session_ids = list(self._containers.keys())
        for sid in session_ids:
            self.stop(sid)
        logger.info("Shut down %d sidecar containers", len(session_ids))

@dataclass
class ContainerConfig:

    runtime: str = "runsc"
    memory_limit: str = "256m"
    cpu_limit: float = 0.5
    max_lifetime_seconds: int = 600
    network: str = "agent-sandbox"


@dataclass
class ContainerInfo:
    container_id: str
    session_id: str
    ip_address: str
    port: int = 3000
    created_at: datetime = field(default_factory=lambda: datetime.now(timezone.utc))
    _container: object = field(default=None, repr=False)

    @property
    def url(self) -> str:
        return f"http://{self.ip_address}:{self.port}"


class ContainerManager:
    """Manages per-session gVisor-sandboxed sidecar containers."""

    def __init__(self, config: ContainerConfig | None = None):
        self._config = config or ContainerConfig()
        self._client = docker.from_env()
        self._containers: dict[str, ContainerInfo] = {}

    def create(self, session_id: str, env: dict[str, str]) -> ContainerInfo:
        """Spin up a new sidecar container for a session."""
        if session_id in self._containers:
            return self._containers[session_id]

        container = self._client.containers.run(
            image=self._config.image,
            detach=True,
            runtime=self._config.runtime,
            mem_limit=self._config.memory_limit,
            nano_cpus=int(self._config.cpu_limit * 1e9),
            read_only=True,
            cap_drop=["ALL"],
            security_opt=["no-new-privileges"],
            tmpfs={"/tmp": "size=50m"},
            network=self._config.network,
            environment=env,
            labels={

                "session_id": session_id,
            },
            auto_remove=False,
        )

        container.reload()
        networks = container.attrs.get("NetworkSettings", {}).get("Networks", {})
        network_info = networks.get(self._config.network, {})
        ip_address = network_info.get("IPAddress", "127.0.0.1")

        info = ContainerInfo(
            container_id=container.id,
            session_id=session_id,
            ip_address=ip_address,
            _container=container,
        )
        self._containers[session_id] = info
        logger.info(
            "Created sidecar container %s for session %s at %s",
            container.id[:12],
            session_id,
            info.url,
        )

        """Get container info for a session."""
        return self._containers.get(session_id)

        return len(expired)

    def shutdown_all(self) -> None:

        if session_id in self._containers:

        container = self._client.containers.run(

            detach=True,
            runtime=self._config.runtime,
            mem_limit=self._config.memory_limit,
            nano_cpus=int(self._config.cpu_limit * 1e9),

import logging
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone

import docker

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


@dataclass
class ContainerConfig:
    image: str = "duckdb-agent-sidecar:latest"
    runtime: str = "runsc"
    memory_limit: str = "256m"
    cpu_limit: float = 0.5
    max_lifetime_seconds: int = 600
    network: str = "agent-sandbox"


@dataclass
class ContainerInfo:
    container_id: str
    session_id: str
    ip_address: str
    port: int = 3000
    created_at: datetime = field(default_factory=lambda: datetime.now(timezone.utc))
    _container: object = field(default=None, repr=False)

    @property
    def url(self) -> str:
        return f"http://{self.ip_address}:{self.port}"


class ContainerManager:
    """Manages per-session gVisor-sandboxed sidecar containers."""

    def __init__(self, config: ContainerConfig | None = None):
        self._config = config or ContainerConfig()
        self._client = docker.from_env()
        self._containers: dict[str, ContainerInfo] = {}

    def create(self, session_id: str, env: dict[str, str]) -> ContainerInfo:
        """Spin up a new sidecar container for a session."""
        if session_id in self._containers:
            return self._containers[session_id]

        container = self._client.containers.run(
            image=self._config.image,
            detach=True,
            runtime=self._config.runtime,
            mem_limit=self._config.memory_limit,
            nano_cpus=int(self._config.cpu_limit * 1e9),
            read_only=True,
            cap_drop=["ALL"],
            security_opt=["no-new-privileges"],
            tmpfs={"/tmp": "size=50m"},
            network=self._config.network,
            environment=env,
            labels={
                "app": "duckdb-agent-sidecar",
                "session_id": session_id,
            },
            auto_remove=False,
        )

        container.reload()
        networks = container.attrs.get("NetworkSettings", {}).get("Networks", {})
        network_info = networks.get(self._config.network, {})
        ip_address = network_info.get("IPAddress", "127.0.0.1")

        info = ContainerInfo(
            container_id=container.id,
            session_id=session_id,
            ip_address=ip_address,
            _container=container,
        )
        self._containers[session_id] = info
        logger.info(
            "Created sidecar container %s for session %s at %s",
            container.id[:12],
            session_id,
            info.url,
        )
        return info

    def get(self, session_id: str) -> ContainerInfo | None:
        """Get container info for a session."""
        return self._containers.get(session_id)

    def stop(self, session_id: str) -> None:
        """Stop and remove the container for a session."""
        info = self._containers.pop(session_id, None)
        if info is None:
            return

        container = info._container
        try:
            container.stop(timeout=5)
        except Exception as e:
            logger.warning("Failed to stop container %s: %s", info.container_id[:12], e)
        try:
            container.remove(force=True)
        except Exception as e:
            logger.warning("Failed to remove container %s: %s", info.container_id[:12], e)

        logger.info("Stopped sidecar container %s for session %s", info.container_id[:12], session_id)

    def cleanup_expired(self) -> int:
        """Remove containers that have exceeded max lifetime."""
        cutoff = datetime.now(timezone.utc) - timedelta(seconds=self._config.max_lifetime_seconds)
        expired = [
            sid for sid, info in self._containers.items()
            if info.created_at < cutoff
        ]
        for sid in expired:
            logger.info("Container for session %s exceeded max lifetime, removing", sid)
            self.stop(sid)
        return len(expired)

    def shutdown_all(self) -> None:
        """Stop and remove all active containers. Called on backend shutdown."""
        session_ids = list(self._containers.keys())
        for sid in session_ids:
            self.stop(sid)
        logger.info("Shut down %d sidecar containers", len(session_ids))

import logging
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone

import docker

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


@dataclass
class ContainerConfig:
    image: str = "duckdb-agent-sidecar:latest"
    runtime: str = "runsc"
    memory_limit: str = "256m"
    cpu_limit: float = 0.5
    max_lifetime_seconds: int = 600
    network: str = "agent-sandbox"


@dataclass
class ContainerInfo:
    container_id: str
    session_id: str
    ip_address: str
    port: int = 3000
    created_at: datetime = field(default_factory=lambda: datetime.now(timezone.utc))
    _container: object = field(default=None, repr=False)

    @property
    def url(self) -> str:
        return f"http://{self.ip_address}:{self.port}"


class ContainerManager:
    """Manages per-session gVisor-sandboxed sidecar containers."""

    def __init__(self, config: ContainerConfig | None = None):
        self._config = config or ContainerConfig()
        self._client = docker.from_env()
        self._containers: dict[str, ContainerInfo] = {}

    def create(self, session_id: str, env: dict[str, str]) -> ContainerInfo:
        """Spin up a new sidecar container for a session."""
        if session_id in self._containers:
            return self._containers[session_id]

        container = self._client.containers.run(
            image=self._config.image,
            detach=True,
            runtime=self._config.runtime,
            mem_limit=self._config.memory_limit,
            nano_cpus=int(self._config.cpu_limit * 1e9),
            read_only=True,
            cap_drop=["ALL"],
            security_opt=["no-new-privileges"],
            tmpfs={"/tmp": "size=50m"},
            network=self._config.network,
            environment=env,
            labels={
                "app": "duckdb-agent-sidecar",
                "session_id": session_id,
            },
            auto_remove=False,
        )

        container.reload()
        networks = container.attrs.get("NetworkSettings", {}).get("Networks", {})
        network_info = networks.get(self._config.network, {})
        ip_address = network_info.get("IPAddress", "127.0.0.1")

        info = ContainerInfo(
            container_id=container.id,
            session_id=session_id,
            ip_address=ip_address,
            _container=container,
        )
        self._containers[session_id] = info
        logger.info(
            "Created sidecar container %s for session %s at %s",
            container.id[:12],
            session_id,
            info.url,
        )
        return info

    def get(self, session_id: str) -> ContainerInfo | None:
        """Get container info for a session."""
        return self._containers.get(session_id)

    def stop(self, session_id: str) -> None:
        """Stop and remove the container for a session."""
        info = self._containers.pop(session_id, None)
        if info is None:
            return

        container = info._container
        try:
            container.stop(timeout=5)
        except Exception as e:
            logger.warning("Failed to stop container %s: %s", info.container_id[:12], e)
        try:
            container.remove(force=True)
        except Exception as e:
            logger.warning("Failed to remove container %s: %s", info.container_id[:12], e)

        logger.info("Stopped sidecar container %s for session %s", info.container_id[:12], session_id)

    def cleanup_expired(self) -> int:
        """Remove containers that have exceeded max lifetime."""
        cutoff = datetime.now(timezone.utc) - timedelta(seconds=self._config.max_lifetime_seconds)
        expired = [
            sid for sid, info in self._containers.items()
            if info.created_at < cutoff
        ]
        for sid in expired:
            logger.info("Container for session %s exceeded max lifetime, removing", sid)
            self.stop(sid)
        return len(expired)

    def shutdown_all(self) -> None:
        """Stop and remove all active containers. Called on backend shutdown."""
        session_ids = list(self._containers.keys())
        for sid in session_ids:
            self.stop(sid)
        logger.info("Shut down %d sidecar containers", len(session_ids))

import docker

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


@dataclass
class ContainerConfig:
    image: str = "duckdb-agent-sidecar:latest"
    runtime: str = "runsc"
    memory_limit: str = "256m"
    cpu_limit: float = 0.5
    max_lifetime_seconds: int = 600
    network: str = "agent-sandbox"


@dataclass
class ContainerInfo:
    container_id: str
    session_id: str
    ip_address: str
    port: int = 3000
    created_at: datetime = field(default_factory=lambda: datetime.now(timezone.utc))
    _container: object = field(default=None, repr=False)

    @property
    def url(self) -> str:
        return f"http://{self.ip_address}:{self.port}"


class ContainerManager:
    """Manages per-session gVisor-sandboxed sidecar containers."""

    def __init__(self, config: ContainerConfig | None = None):
        self._config = config or ContainerConfig()
        self._client = docker.from_env()
        self._containers: dict[str, ContainerInfo] = {}

    def create(self, session_id: str, env: dict[str, str]) -> ContainerInfo:
        """Spin up a new sidecar container for a session."""
        if session_id in self._containers:
            return self._containers[session_id]

        container = self._client.containers.run(
            image=self._config.image,
            detach=True,
            runtime=self._config.runtime,
            mem_limit=self._config.memory_limit,
            nano_cpus=int(self._config.cpu_limit * 1e9),
            read_only=True,
            cap_drop=["ALL"],
            security_opt=["no-new-privileges"],
            tmpfs={"/tmp": "size=50m"},
            network=self._config.network,
            environment=env,
            labels={
                "app": "duckdb-agent-sidecar",
                "session_id": session_id,
            },
            auto_remove=False,
        )

        container.reload()
        networks = container.attrs.get("NetworkSettings", {}).get("Networks", {})
        network_info = networks.get(self._config.network, {})
        ip_address = network_info.get("IPAddress", "127.0.0.1")

        info = ContainerInfo(
            container_id=container.id,
            session_id=session_id,
            ip_address=ip_address,
            _container=container,
        )
        self._containers[session_id] = info
        logger.info(
            "Created sidecar container %s for session %s at %s",
            container.id[:12],
            session_id,
            info.url,
        )
        return info

    def get(self, session_id: str) -> ContainerInfo | None:
        """Get container info for a session."""
        return self._containers.get(session_id)

    def stop(self, session_id: str) -> None:
        """Stop and remove the container for a session."""
        info = self._containers.pop(session_id, None)
        if info is None:

        container = info._container
        try:

        except Exception as e:
            logger.warning("Failed to remove container %s: %s", info.container_id[:12], e)

        logger.info("Stopped sidecar container %s for session %s", info.container_id[:12], session_id)

    def cleanup_expired(self) -> int:
        """Remove containers that have exceeded max lifetime."""
        cutoff = datetime.now(timezone.utc) - timedelta(seconds=self._config.max_lifetime_seconds)
        expired = [
            sid for sid, info in self._containers.items()
            if info.created_at < cutoff
        ]
        for sid in expired:
            logger.info("Container for session %s exceeded max lifetime, removing", sid)
            self.stop(sid)
        return len(expired)

    def shutdown_all(self) -> None:
        """Stop and remove all active containers. Called on backend shutdown."""
        session_ids = list(self._containers.keys())
        for sid in session_ids:
            self.stop(sid)
        logger.info("Shut down %d sidecar containers", len(session_ids))

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


@dataclass
class ContainerConfig:

    runtime: str = "runsc"
    memory_limit: str = "256m"
    cpu_limit: float = 0.5
    max_lifetime_seconds: int = 600
    network: str = "agent-sandbox"


@dataclass
class ContainerInfo:
    container_id: str
    session_id: str
    ip_address: str
    port: int = 3000
    created_at: datetime = field(default_factory=lambda: datetime.now(timezone.utc))
    _container: object = field(default=None, repr=False)

    @property
    def url(self) -> str:
        return f"http://{self.ip_address}:{self.port}"


class ContainerManager:
    """Manages per-session gVisor-sandboxed sidecar containers."""

    def __init__(self, config: ContainerConfig | None = None):
        self._config = config or ContainerConfig()
        self._client = docker.from_env()
        self._containers: dict[str, ContainerInfo] = {}

    def create(self, session_id: str, env: dict[str, str]) -> ContainerInfo:
        """Spin up a new sidecar container for a session."""
        if session_id in self._containers:
            return self._containers[session_id]

        container = self._client.containers.run(
            image=self._config.image,
            detach=True,
            runtime=self._config.runtime,
            mem_limit=self._config.memory_limit,
            nano_cpus=int(self._config.cpu_limit * 1e9),
            read_only=True,
            cap_drop=["ALL"],
            security_opt=["no-new-privileges"],
            tmpfs={"/tmp": "size=50m"},
            network=self._config.network,
            environment=env,
            labels={
                "app": "duckdb-agent-sidecar",
                "session_id": session_id,
            },
            auto_remove=False,
        )

        container.reload()
        networks = container.attrs.get("NetworkSettings", {}).get("Networks", {})
        network_info = networks.get(self._config.network, {})
        ip_address = network_info.get("IPAddress", "127.0.0.1")

        info = ContainerInfo(
            container_id=container.id,
            session_id=session_id,
            ip_address=ip_address,
            _container=container,
        )
        self._containers[session_id] = info
        logger.info(
            "Created sidecar container %s for session %s at %s",
            container.id[:12],
            session_id,
            info.url,
        )
        return info

        """Get container info for a session."""
        return self._containers.get(session_id)

    def stop(self, session_id: str) -> None:

        info = self._containers.pop(session_id, None)

            if info.created_at < cutoff

            self.stop(sid)
        return len(expired)

import logging
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone

import docker

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


@dataclass
class ContainerConfig:
    image: str = "duckdb-agent-sidecar:latest"
    runtime: str = "runsc"
    memory_limit: str = "256m"
    cpu_limit: float = 0.5
    max_lifetime_seconds: int = 600
    network: str = "agent-sandbox"


@dataclass
class ContainerInfo:
    container_id: str
    session_id: str
    ip_address: str
    port: int = 3000
    created_at: datetime = field(default_factory=lambda: datetime.now(timezone.utc))
    _container: object = field(default=None, repr=False)

    @property
    def url(self) -> str:
        return f"http://{self.ip_address}:{self.port}"


class ContainerManager:
    """Manages per-session gVisor-sandboxed sidecar containers."""

    def __init__(self, config: ContainerConfig | None = None):
        self._config = config or ContainerConfig()
        self._client = docker.from_env()
        self._containers: dict[str, ContainerInfo] = {}

    def create(self, session_id: str, env: dict[str, str]) -> ContainerInfo:
        """Spin up a new sidecar container for a session."""
        if session_id in self._containers:
            return self._containers[session_id]

        container = self._client.containers.run(
            image=self._config.image,
            detach=True,
            runtime=self._config.runtime,
            mem_limit=self._config.memory_limit,
            nano_cpus=int(self._config.cpu_limit * 1e9),
            read_only=True,
            cap_drop=["ALL"],
            security_opt=["no-new-privileges"],
            tmpfs={"/tmp": "size=50m"},
            network=self._config.network,
            environment=env,
            labels={
                "app": "duckdb-agent-sidecar",
                "session_id": session_id,
            },
            auto_remove=False,
        )

        container.reload()
        networks = container.attrs.get("NetworkSettings", {}).get("Networks", {})
        network_info = networks.get(self._config.network, {})
        ip_address = network_info.get("IPAddress", "127.0.0.1")

        info = ContainerInfo(
            container_id=container.id,
            session_id=session_id,
            ip_address=ip_address,
            _container=container,
        )
        self._containers[session_id] = info
        logger.info(
            "Created sidecar container %s for session %s at %s",
            container.id[:12],
            session_id,
            info.url,
        )
        return info

    def get(self, session_id: str) -> ContainerInfo | None:
        """Get container info for a session."""
        return self._containers.get(session_id)

    def stop(self, session_id: str) -> None:
        """Stop and remove the container for a session."""
        info = self._containers.pop(session_id, None)
        if info is None:
            return

        container = info._container
        try:
            container.stop(timeout=5)
        except Exception as e:
            logger.warning("Failed to stop container %s: %s", info.container_id[:12], e)
        try:
            container.remove(force=True)
        except Exception as e:
            logger.warning("Failed to remove container %s: %s", info.container_id[:12], e)

        logger.info("Stopped sidecar container %s for session %s", info.container_id[:12], session_id)

    def cleanup_expired(self) -> int:
        """Remove containers that have exceeded max lifetime."""
        cutoff = datetime.now(timezone.utc) - timedelta(seconds=self._config.max_lifetime_seconds)
        expired = [
            sid for sid, info in self._containers.items()
            if info.created_at < cutoff
        ]
        for sid in expired:
            logger.info("Container for session %s exceeded max lifetime, removing", sid)
            self.stop(sid)
        return len(expired)

    def shutdown_all(self) -> None:
        """Stop and remove all active containers. Called on backend shutdown."""
        session_ids = list(self._containers.keys())
        for sid in session_ids:
            self.stop(sid)
        logger.info("Shut down %d sidecar containers", len(session_ids))

import logging
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone

import docker

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


@dataclass
class ContainerConfig:
    image: str = "duckdb-agent-sidecar:latest"
    runtime: str = "runsc"
    memory_limit: str = "256m"
    cpu_limit: float = 0.5
    max_lifetime_seconds: int = 600
    network: str = "agent-sandbox"


@dataclass
class ContainerInfo:
    container_id: str
    session_id: str
    ip_address: str
    port: int = 3000
    created_at: datetime = field(default_factory=lambda: datetime.now(timezone.utc))
    _container: object = field(default=None, repr=False)

    @property
    def url(self) -> str:
        return f"http://{self.ip_address}:{self.port}"


class ContainerManager:
    """Manages per-session gVisor-sandboxed sidecar containers."""

    def __init__(self, config: ContainerConfig | None = None):
        self._config = config or ContainerConfig()
        self._client = docker.from_env()
        self._containers: dict[str, ContainerInfo] = {}

    def create(self, session_id: str, env: dict[str, str]) -> ContainerInfo:
        """Spin up a new sidecar container for a session."""
        if session_id in self._containers:
            return self._containers[session_id]

        container = self._client.containers.run(
            image=self._config.image,
            detach=True,
            runtime=self._config.runtime,
            mem_limit=self._config.memory_limit,
            nano_cpus=int(self._config.cpu_limit * 1e9),
            read_only=True,
            cap_drop=["ALL"],
            security_opt=["no-new-privileges"],
            tmpfs={"/tmp": "size=50m"},
            network=self._config.network,
            environment=env,
            labels={
                "app": "duckdb-agent-sidecar",
                "session_id": session_id,
            },
            auto_remove=False,
        )

        container.reload()
        networks = container.attrs.get("NetworkSettings", {}).get("Networks", {})
        network_info = networks.get(self._config.network, {})
        ip_address = network_info.get("IPAddress", "127.0.0.1")

        info = ContainerInfo(
            container_id=container.id,
            session_id=session_id,
            ip_address=ip_address,
            _container=container,
        )
        self._containers[session_id] = info
        logger.info(
            "Created sidecar container %s for session %s at %s",
            container.id[:12],
            session_id,
            info.url,
        )
        return info

    def get(self, session_id: str) -> ContainerInfo | None:
        """Get container info for a session."""
        return self._containers.get(session_id)

    def stop(self, session_id: str) -> None:
        """Stop and remove the container for a session."""
        info = self._containers.pop(session_id, None)
        if info is None:
            return

        container = info._container
        try:
            container.stop(timeout=5)
        except Exception as e:
            logger.warning("Failed to stop container %s: %s", info.container_id[:12], e)
        try:
            container.remove(force=True)
        except Exception as e:
            logger.warning("Failed to remove container %s: %s", info.container_id[:12], e)

        logger.info("Stopped sidecar container %s for session %s", info.container_id[:12], session_id)

    def cleanup_expired(self) -> int:
        """Remove containers that have exceeded max lifetime."""
        cutoff = datetime.now(timezone.utc) - timedelta(seconds=self._config.max_lifetime_seconds)
        expired = [
            sid for sid, info in self._containers.items()
            if info.created_at < cutoff
        ]
        for sid in expired:
            logger.info("Container for session %s exceeded max lifetime, removing", sid)
            self.stop(sid)
        return len(expired)

    def shutdown_all(self) -> None:
        """Stop and remove all active containers. Called on backend shutdown."""
        session_ids = list(self._containers.keys())
        for sid in session_ids:
            self.stop(sid)
        logger.info("Shut down %d sidecar containers", len(session_ids))

import logging
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone

import docker

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


@dataclass
class ContainerConfig:
    image: str = "duckdb-agent-sidecar:latest"
    runtime: str = "runsc"
    memory_limit: str = "256m"
    cpu_limit: float = 0.5
    max_lifetime_seconds: int = 600
    network: str = "agent-sandbox"


@dataclass
class ContainerInfo:
    container_id: str
    session_id: str
    ip_address: str
    port: int = 3000
    created_at: datetime = field(default_factory=lambda: datetime.now(timezone.utc))
    _container: object = field(default=None, repr=False)

    @property
    def url(self) -> str:
        return f"http://{self.ip_address}:{self.port}"


class ContainerManager:
    """Manages per-session gVisor-sandboxed sidecar containers."""

    def __init__(self, config: ContainerConfig | None = None):
        self._config = config or ContainerConfig()
        self._client = docker.from_env()
        self._containers: dict[str, ContainerInfo] = {}

    def create(self, session_id: str, env: dict[str, str]) -> ContainerInfo:
        """Spin up a new sidecar container for a session."""
        if session_id in self._containers:
            return self._containers[session_id]

        container = self._client.containers.run(
            image=self._config.image,
            detach=True,
            runtime=self._config.runtime,
            mem_limit=self._config.memory_limit,
            nano_cpus=int(self._config.cpu_limit * 1e9),
            read_only=True,
            cap_drop=["ALL"],
            security_opt=["no-new-privileges"],
            tmpfs={"/tmp": "size=50m"},
            network=self._config.network,
            environment=env,
            labels={
                "app": "duckdb-agent-sidecar",
                "session_id": session_id,
            },
            auto_remove=False,
        )

        container.reload()
        networks = container.attrs.get("NetworkSettings", {}).get("Networks", {})
        network_info = networks.get(self._config.network, {})
        ip_address = network_info.get("IPAddress", "127.0.0.1")

        info = ContainerInfo(
            container_id=container.id,
            session_id=session_id,
            ip_address=ip_address,
            _container=container,
        )
        self._containers[session_id] = info
        logger.info(
            "Created sidecar container %s for session %s at %s",
            container.id[:12],
            session_id,
            info.url,
        )
        return info

    def get(self, session_id: str) -> ContainerInfo | None:
        """Get container info for a session."""
        return self._containers.get(session_id)

    def stop(self, session_id: str) -> None:
        """Stop and remove the container for a session."""
        info = self._containers.pop(session_id, None)
        if info is None:
            return

        container = info._container
        try:
            container.stop(timeout=5)
        except Exception as e:
            logger.warning("Failed to stop container %s: %s", info.container_id[:12], e)
        try:
            container.remove(force=True)
        except Exception as e:
            logger.warning("Failed to remove container %s: %s", info.container_id[:12], e)

        logger.info("Stopped sidecar container %s for session %s", info.container_id[:12], session_id)

    def cleanup_expired(self) -> int:
        """Remove containers that have exceeded max lifetime."""
        cutoff = datetime.now(timezone.utc) - timedelta(seconds=self._config.max_lifetime_seconds)
        expired = [
            sid for sid, info in self._containers.items()
            if info.created_at < cutoff
        ]
        for sid in expired:
            logger.info("Container for session %s exceeded max lifetime, removing", sid)
            self.stop(sid)
        return len(expired)

    def shutdown_all(self) -> None:
        """Stop and remove all active containers. Called on backend shutdown."""
        session_ids = list(self._containers.keys())
        for sid in session_ids:
            self.stop(sid)
        logger.info("Shut down %d sidecar containers", len(session_ids))

import logging
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone

import docker

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


@dataclass
class ContainerConfig:
    image: str = "duckdb-agent-sidecar:latest"
    runtime: str = "runsc"
    memory_limit: str = "256m"
    cpu_limit: float = 0.5
    max_lifetime_seconds: int = 600
    network: str = "agent-sandbox"


@dataclass
class ContainerInfo:
    container_id: str
    session_id: str
    ip_address: str
    port: int = 3000
    created_at: datetime = field(default_factory=lambda: datetime.now(timezone.utc))
    _container: object = field(default=None, repr=False)

    @property
    def url(self) -> str:
        return f"http://{self.ip_address}:{self.port}"


class ContainerManager:
    """Manages per-session gVisor-sandboxed sidecar containers."""

    def __init__(self, config: ContainerConfig | None = None):
        self._config = config or ContainerConfig()
        self._client = docker.from_env()
        self._containers: dict[str, ContainerInfo] = {}

    def create(self, session_id: str, env: dict[str, str]) -> ContainerInfo:
        """Spin up a new sidecar container for a session."""
        if session_id in self._containers:
            return self._containers[session_id]

        container = self._client.containers.run(
            image=self._config.image,
            detach=True,
            runtime=self._config.runtime,
            mem_limit=self._config.memory_limit,
            nano_cpus=int(self._config.cpu_limit * 1e9),
            read_only=True,
            cap_drop=["ALL"],
            security_opt=["no-new-privileges"],
            tmpfs={"/tmp": "size=50m"},
            network=self._config.network,
            environment=env,
            labels={
                "app": "duckdb-agent-sidecar",
                "session_id": session_id,
            },
            auto_remove=False,
        )

        container.reload()
        networks = container.attrs.get("NetworkSettings", {}).get("Networks", {})
        network_info = networks.get(self._config.network, {})
        ip_address = network_info.get("IPAddress", "127.0.0.1")

        info = ContainerInfo(
            container_id=container.id,
            session_id=session_id,
            ip_address=ip_address,
            _container=container,
        )
        self._containers[session_id] = info
        logger.info(
            "Created sidecar container %s for session %s at %s",
            container.id[:12],
            session_id,
            info.url,
        )
        return info

    def get(self, session_id: str) -> ContainerInfo | None:
        """Get container info for a session."""
        return self._containers.get(session_id)

    def stop(self, session_id: str) -> None:
        """Stop and remove the container for a session."""
        info = self._containers.pop(session_id, None)
        if info is None:
            return

        container = info._container
        try:
            container.stop(timeout=5)
        except Exception as e:
            logger.warning("Failed to stop container %s: %s", info.container_id[:12], e)
        try:
            container.remove(force=True)
        except Exception as e:
            logger.warning("Failed to remove container %s: %s", info.container_id[:12], e)

        logger.info("Stopped sidecar container %s for session %s", info.container_id[:12], session_id)

    def cleanup_expired(self) -> int:
        """Remove containers that have exceeded max lifetime."""
        cutoff = datetime.now(timezone.utc) - timedelta(seconds=self._config.max_lifetime_seconds)
        expired = [
            sid for sid, info in self._containers.items()
            if info.created_at < cutoff
        ]
        for sid in expired:
            logger.info("Container for session %s exceeded max lifetime, removing", sid)
            self.stop(sid)
        return len(expired)

    def shutdown_all(self) -> None:
        """Stop and remove all active containers. Called on backend shutdown."""
        session_ids = list(self._containers.keys())
        for sid in session_ids:
            self.stop(sid)
        logger.info("Shut down %d sidecar containers", len(session_ids))

    session_id: str
    ip_address: str

    created_at: datetime = field(default_factory=lambda: datetime.now(timezone.utc))

class ContainerManager:

        self._client = docker.from_env()
        self._containers: dict[str, ContainerInfo] = {}

    def create(self, session_id: str, env: dict[str, str]) -> ContainerInfo:
        """Spin up a new sidecar container for a session."""
        if session_id in self._containers:
            return self._containers[session_id]

        container = self._client.containers.run(
            image=self._config.image,
            detach=True,
            runtime=self._config.runtime,
            mem_limit=self._config.memory_limit,
            nano_cpus=int(self._config.cpu_limit * 1e9),
            read_only=True,
            cap_drop=["ALL"],

            tmpfs={"/tmp": "size=50m"},

        info = ContainerInfo(
            container_id=container.id,
            session_id=session_id,
            ip_address=ip_address,
            _container=container,
        )

        logger.info(
            "Created sidecar container %s for session %s at %s",
            container.id[:12],

        )

        return len(expired)

    def shutdown_all(self) -> None:

import logging
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone

import docker

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


@dataclass
class ContainerConfig:
    image: str = "duckdb-agent-sidecar:latest"
    runtime: str = "runsc"
    memory_limit: str = "256m"
    cpu_limit: float = 0.5
    max_lifetime_seconds: int = 600
    network: str = "agent-sandbox"


@dataclass
class ContainerInfo:
    container_id: str
    session_id: str
    ip_address: str
    port: int = 3000
    created_at: datetime = field(default_factory=lambda: datetime.now(timezone.utc))
    _container: object = field(default=None, repr=False)

    @property
    def url(self) -> str:
        return f"http://{self.ip_address}:{self.port}"


class ContainerManager:
    """Manages per-session gVisor-sandboxed sidecar containers."""

    def __init__(self, config: ContainerConfig | None = None):
        self._config = config or ContainerConfig()
        self._client = docker.from_env()
        self._containers: dict[str, ContainerInfo] = {}

    def create(self, session_id: str, env: dict[str, str]) -> ContainerInfo:
        """Spin up a new sidecar container for a session."""
        if session_id in self._containers:
            return self._containers[session_id]

        container = self._client.containers.run(
            image=self._config.image,
            detach=True,
            runtime=self._config.runtime,
            mem_limit=self._config.memory_limit,
            nano_cpus=int(self._config.cpu_limit * 1e9),
            read_only=True,
            cap_drop=["ALL"],
            security_opt=["no-new-privileges"],
            tmpfs={"/tmp": "size=50m"},
            network=self._config.network,
            environment=env,
            labels={
                "app": "duckdb-agent-sidecar",
                "session_id": session_id,
            },
            auto_remove=False,
        )

        container.reload()
        networks = container.attrs.get("NetworkSettings", {}).get("Networks", {})
        network_info = networks.get(self._config.network, {})
        ip_address = network_info.get("IPAddress", "127.0.0.1")

        info = ContainerInfo(
            container_id=container.id,
            session_id=session_id,
            ip_address=ip_address,
            _container=container,
        )
        self._containers[session_id] = info
        logger.info(
            "Created sidecar container %s for session %s at %s",
            container.id[:12],
            session_id,
            info.url,
        )
        return info

    def get(self, session_id: str) -> ContainerInfo | None:
        """Get container info for a session."""
        return self._containers.get(session_id)

    def stop(self, session_id: str) -> None:
        """Stop and remove the container for a session."""
        info = self._containers.pop(session_id, None)
        if info is None:
            return

        container = info._container
        try:
            container.stop(timeout=5)
        except Exception as e:
            logger.warning("Failed to stop container %s: %s", info.container_id[:12], e)
        try:
            container.remove(force=True)
        except Exception as e:
            logger.warning("Failed to remove container %s: %s", info.container_id[:12], e)

        logger.info("Stopped sidecar container %s for session %s", info.container_id[:12], session_id)

    def cleanup_expired(self) -> int:
        """Remove containers that have exceeded max lifetime."""
        cutoff = datetime.now(timezone.utc) - timedelta(seconds=self._config.max_lifetime_seconds)
        expired = [
            sid for sid, info in self._containers.items()
            if info.created_at < cutoff
        ]
        for sid in expired:
            logger.info("Container for session %s exceeded max lifetime, removing", sid)
            self.stop(sid)
        return len(expired)

    def shutdown_all(self) -> None:
        """Stop and remove all active containers. Called on backend shutdown."""
        session_ids = list(self._containers.keys())
        for sid in session_ids:
            self.stop(sid)
        logger.info("Shut down %d sidecar containers", len(session_ids))
